from pathlib import Path
import json

p=Path("src/do_again/service/runtime.py")
s=p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
old="""def install_service(path: str | Path = ".") -> dict[str, Any]:
    _require_macos()
    repo = find_repo(path)
    layout = prepare_runtime(repo)
    plist = service_definition_path(layout.label)
    plist.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    plist.write_bytes(plistlib.dumps(_launchd_plist(layout), sort_keys=True))
    os.chmod(plist, 0o644)

    _launchctl("bootout", f"{_domain()}/{layout.label}", check=False)
    boot = _launchctl("bootstrap", _domain(), str(plist), check=False)"""
new="""def install_service(path: str | Path = ".") -> dict[str, Any]:
    _require_macos()
    repo = find_repo(path)
    existing = runtime_layout(repo)
    if _loaded(existing):
        proc = _launchctl("bootout", f"{_domain()}/{existing.label}", check=False)
        if proc.returncode != 0:
            raise ServiceError(f"launchctl bootout failed: {(proc.stderr or proc.stdout).strip()}")
        _wait_loaded(existing, False)

    layout = prepare_runtime(repo)
    plist = service_definition_path(layout.label)
    plist.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    plist.write_bytes(plistlib.dumps(_launchd_plist(layout), sort_keys=True))
    os.chmod(plist, 0o644)

    boot = _launchctl("bootstrap", _domain(), str(plist), check=False)"""
if old not in s: raise SystemExit("install block not found")
s=s.replace(old,new)

        raise ServiceError("background service is already running; stop it before using foreground mode")
    agent = Agent("""

    if detect_platform().name == "macos" and service_status(repo)["running"]:
        raise ServiceError("background service is already running; stop it before using foreground mode")
    layout = prepare_runtime(repo)
    agent = Agent("""
if old not in s: raise SystemExit("foreground block not found")
s=s.replace(old,new)
p.write_text(s,encoding="utf-8")

p=Path("src/do_again/cli.py")
s=p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
s=s.replace("    install_service,\n", "    find_repo,\n    install_service,\n")
old="""def status(path: str = ".") -> int:
    info = detect_platform()
    try:
        value = service_status(path)
    except ServiceError:
        print(f"platform={info.name}")
        print(f"service_manager={info.service_manager}")
        return 0
    _print_service_status(value)
    return 0"""
new="""def status(path: str = ".") -> int:
    info = detect_platform()
    try:
        repo = find_repo(path)
    except ServiceError:
        print(f"platform={info.name}")
        print(f"service_manager={info.service_manager}")
        return 0
    try:
        value = service_status(repo)
    except ServiceError as exc:
        print(f"do-again: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    _print_service_status(value)
    return 0"""
if old not in s: raise SystemExit("status block not found")
s=s.replace(old,new)
p.write_text(s,encoding="utf-8")

p=Path("pyproject.toml")
s=p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").replace('version = "0.1.1"','version = "0.2.0"',1)
p.write_text(s,encoding="utf-8")

p=Path("package.json")
data=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
data["version"]="0.2.0"
p.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
p=Path("package-lock.json")
data=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
data["version"]="0.2.0"
data["packages"][""]["version"]="0.2.0"
p.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")

p=Path("README.md")
s=p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").replace("such as `v0.1.1`", "such as `v0.2.0`")
p.write_text(s,encoding="utf-8")
print("polished lifecycle and bumped 0.2.0")
